βαρεῖαι: βαρύς — heavy, weighty; fem. nom. pl.
βοείας: βόειος — of ox-hide; fem. acc. pl.
γάμοιο: γάμος — marriage, wedding; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
δημήτηρ: Δημήτηρ — Demeter, goddess of grain and harvest; fem. nom. sg.
διοτρεφέεσσι: διοτρεφής — nurtured by Zeus, Zeus-nurtured (epithet of kings/princes); masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
δυσμενέεσσιν: δυσμενής — hostile, ill-disposed; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -έσι)
δῖοι: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. pl. δῖοι, here extended to the Achaeans generally (δῖοι Ἀχαιοί) rather than a single hero
εἴδωλον: εἴδωλον — phantom, image, likeness (esp. a dream-figure sent by a god); neut. nom./acc. sg.
εἶδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg. (εἶδον ’I saw’) · also aor. 3 pl. (the form serves both persons): ’they saw’
ζωόν: ζωός — alive, living; adj., masc. acc. sg.
καλεσσάμενος: καλέω — call, summon; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic καλεσάμενος): ’having called to himself’
καρπόν: καρπός — fruit, grain; masc. acc. sg., object of ἀλετρεύουσι: ’grain’ · also ’fruit’ (λωτοῖο … μελιηδέα καρπόν ’the honey-sweet fruit of the lotus’)
καρπῷ: καρπός — wrist; masc. dat. sg. (distinct from καρπός ’fruit’) · also καρπός — fruit, produce; masc. dat. sg., dat. of cause or respect: ’with fruit’ (βρίθῃσι δένδρεα καρπῷ ’the trees are laden with fruit’)
κελεύεις: κελεύω — bid, command, order; pres. 2 sg.
κύρμα: κύρμα — prey, spoil, booty; neut. nom. sg., predicate with γενέσθαι: ‘to become spoil’
λαοῖσιν: λαός — people, host, folk; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
μαχήσασθαι: μάχομαι — fight; aor. inf., + dat.: ’to fight against’
μελήσει: μέλω — be a care to; fut. 3 sg. (impersonal + dat.): ’will be a care (to)’
μενέμεν: μένω — stay, remain; pres. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic μένειν)
μῦθος: μῦθος — speech, word, thing said; masc. nom. sg.
νήπιον: νήπιος — witless, foolish, childish; masc. acc. sg., predicate (with εἶναι)
ναιομένην: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; pres. pass. part. fem. acc. sg.: ’inhabited’, with εὖ ’well-peopled’
νείκεσεν: νεικέω — quarrel with, taunt, revile; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’taunted’
οἴχεται: οἴχομαι — be gone, have departed; pres. with perf. sense, 3 sg.: ’is gone’
οἷόν: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. acc. sg. correlative with τοῖος (τοῖος ἐὼν οἷόν μιν ’just such as when’) · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial and consecutive: ’so that, such that’ (οἷόν σ’ … οὐδέ σε πείθω) · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, + τε: ’such as, like’ (οἷόν τε κρομύοιο λοπὸν κάτα ’such as is along the skin of an onion’) · also masc. acc. sg., οἷόν τε + inf.: ’such as to, fit to’ (οἷόν τε … ἔμεναι ’such as to be’)
πολύχαλκον: πολύχαλκος — rich in bronze, of much bronze (epithet of the sky); masc. acc. sg.
προσιόντα: πρόσειμι (εἶμι) — go to, approach; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’approaching’
σαώσομεν: σαόω — save, keep safe (= σῴζω); fut. 1 pl., epic uncontracted (or hortative aor. subj.): ’we shall save, let us save’
σπέσθαι: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; aor. inf.: ’to follow’
τέταρτον: τέταρτος — fourth; ordinal numeral, neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg. with the article: τὸν τέταρτον ’the fourth (man)’
τεύχεσι: τεῦχος — (pl.) armour, gear; neut. dat. pl.
τηλοῦ: τηλοῦ — far off, at a distance; adv.
υἱάσι: υἱός — son; masc. dat. pl., epic stem υἱ- (= Attic υἱοῖς/υἱέσι)
φίλησε: φιλέω — love, treat as dear; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφίλησε): ’loved’
φαεινὴν: φαεινός — bright, shining; fem. acc. sg. (epic by-form of φανός)
φοίβου: Φοῖβος — Phoebus (’bright’), epithet of Apollo; masc. gen. sg.
φράζεο: φράζομαι — take note, observe, consider; pres. mid. imper. 2 sg.: ’mark, take note’
φόβηθεν: φοβέω — frighten; pass. flee in fear; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic unaugmented -θεν (= Attic ἐφοβήθησαν): ’fled in fear’
φῦλον: φῦλον — tribe, race, kind; neut. acc. sg.
χείρ: χείρ — hand; fem. acc. sg., elided (χεῖρ’ = χεῖρα)
χειρῶν: χείρ — hand; gen. pl., genitive of separation: ’from their hands’ · also gen. pl., dependent on μνῆμα: ’of Helen’s hands’ (μνῆμ’ Ἑλένης χειρῶν ’a memorial of Helen’s hands’) · also gen. pl. governed by γεύσασθαι: χειρῶν γεύσασθαι ’to make trial of hands’ · also gen. pl. after πειρήσομαι: ’trial of (one’s own) hands’ (χειρῶν … πειρήσομαι)
χεῖρ: χείρ — hand; fem. acc. sg., elided (χεῖρ’ = χεῖρα)
ἀλευάμενος: ἀλέομαι (ἀλεύομαι) — avoid, escape; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic (Attic φυγών): ’avoiding’
ἀμυνέμεναι: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; pres. inf., epic -έμεναι (= Attic ἀμύνειν)
ἀμφοτέρῃσιν: ἀμφότερος — both; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic -αις): ’with both (hands)’
ἀολλέες: ἀολλής — all together, in a body; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιϊάδων: Ἀχαιιάς — Achaean woman; fem. gen. pl.
ἄγοιεν: ἄγω — lead, carry off; pres. opt. 3 pl., in a clause of ὄφρ’ ἂν ’until’: ’should carry’
ἄκρῃ: ἄκρη — headland, height; fem. dat. sg., Ionic η (= Attic ἄκρᾳ)
ἐναντίοι: ἐναντίος — opposite, facing; masc. nom. pl.
ἐνιπήν: ἐνιπή — rebuke, reproof, threat; fem. acc. sg.
ἐπέσσυτο: ἐπισεύομαι — rush upon, come upon swiftly; aor. 3 sg., epic reduplicated, unaugmented
ἐποιχόμενος: ἐποίχομαι — go against, assail, come upon; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ‘assailing’
ἐρέθιζον: ἐρεθίζω — provoke, goad; impf. 3 pl. act.
ἐτίομεν: τίω — honour, esteem; impf. 1 pl., augmented: ’we were honouring’
ἐφέζετο: ἐφέζομαι — sit down, take a seat; impf. 3 sg., aoristic sense (= Attic ἐκαθέζετο): ’sat down’
ἑκάστου: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. gen. sg.
ἔγειρε: ἐγείρω — rouse, wake; indic. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἤγειρε), aor. or impf. (the Attic form is the same for both): ’woke’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’wake!’
ἔγειρεν: ἐγείρω — wake, rouse, stir up; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἤγειρεν), with movable ν
ἔχοντα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ‘holding’ · also with ἄλγεα, masc. acc. sg.: ’suffering, enduring’ (κρατέρ’ ἄλγε’ ἔχοντα ’beset by harsh pains’) · also of clothing, masc. acc. sg.: ’wearing’ (τοιάδε λαίφε’ ἔχοντα ’wearing such rags’)
ἕλωρ: ἕλωρ — prey, spoil, plunder; neut. nom. sg., predicate with γενέσθαι: ‘to become prey’
ἰθὺς: ἰθύς — straight; prep. + gen. (epic = Attic εὐθύς): ’straight towards’ · also adv., no case expressed: ’straight, straight on’
ἱερὰς: ἱερός — sacred, holy; fem. acc. pl.
ἴκελον: ἴκελος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ὅμοιος)
ἶσος: ἴσος — equal, like (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg., epic ἶσος
ὀτρύνω: ὀτρύνω — urge on, stir; pres. 1 sg. indic. or subj.: ’I urge’ / ’I may urge’, with an inf. of what is urged
ὁμοκλήσας: ὁμοκλέω (ὁμοκλάω) — shout at, rebuke; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
ὁμοῖον: ὅμοιος — like, similar; masc. acc. sg., as a noun with the article: τὸν ὁμοῖον ’the like’
